ficha_datos_generales.descripcion: The following are some questions about general information about you or your occupation. Please select only one answer for each question and mark it or write it in the box. Write clearly and legibly.

campos.campo: What is your occupation or profession?
Select and mark the socioeconomic stratum (estrato) of the public utilities of your home
Number of people who depend on you financially (even if they live elsewhere)

Si lleva más de un año, anote cuántos años

If you have been here more than one year, write how many years

campos.campo: What is the title of the position you hold in the company?
Select the type of position most similar to the one you hold
How many years have you held your current position or job at this company?

Si lleva más de un año, anote cuántos años
opciones_en: If you have been here less than one year, mark this option
If you have been here more than one year, write how many years

campos.campo: Write the name of the department, area or section of the company where you work

forma_a_intralaboral.nombre: Workplace Psychosocial Risk Factors Questionnaire - Form A
forma_a_intralaboral.instrucciones: This psychosocial factors questionnaire seeks to learn your opinion about some aspects of your work. We kindly ask you to answer the following questions with complete honesty. The answers you give in this questionnaire are neither good nor bad; what matters is that they reflect the way you think about your work.

condiciones_ambientales.descripcion: The following questions relate to the environmental conditions of the site(s) or place(s) where you usually do your work.

preguntas.texto: The noise in the place where I work is bothersome
It is very cold in the place where I work
It is very hot in the place where I work
The air in the place where I work is fresh and pleasant
The lighting in the place where I work is pleasant
The space where I work is comfortable
In my job I worry about being exposed to chemical substances that may affect my health
My job requires me to make a lot of physical effort
The equipment or tools I work with are comfortable
In my job I worry about being exposed to germs, animals or plants that may affect my health
I worry about having an accident at work
The place where I work is clean and tidy

demandas_cuantitativas.descripcion: To answer the following questions, think about the amount of work you are in charge of.

preguntas.texto: Because of the amount of work I have, I must stay extra time
My working time is enough to keep my duties up to date
Because of the amount of work I have, I must work without stopping

demandas_carga_mental.descripcion: The following questions relate to the mental effort your work requires of you.

preguntas.texto: My job requires me to make a lot of mental effort
My job requires me to be highly concentrated
My job requires me to memorize a lot of information
In my job I have to make difficult decisions very quickly
My job requires me to attend to many matters at the same time
My job requires me to pay attention to small details

responsabilidades.descripcion: The following questions relate to the responsibilities and activities you must carry out in your work

preguntas.texto: In my job I am responsible for things of great value
In my job I am responsible for company money
As part of my duties I must be responsible for the safety of others
I answer to my boss for the results of my entire work area
My job requires me to look after the health of other people
At work I am given contradictory orders
In my job I am asked to do unnecessary things
In my job situations arise in which I must overlook rules or procedures
In my job I have to do things that could be done in a more practical way

jornada_trabajo.descripcion: The following questions relate to your working hours.

preguntas.texto: I work night shifts
In my job it is possible to take breaks to rest
My job requires me to work on rest days, holidays or weekends
In my job I can take weekends or rest days each month
When I am at home I keep thinking about work
I argue with my family or friends because of my work
I must attend to work matters when I am at home
Because of my work, the time I spend with my family and friends is very little

control_autonomia.descripcion: The following questions relate to the decisions and control your work allows you.

preguntas.texto: My job allows me to develop my skills
My job allows me to apply my knowledge
My job allows me to learn new things
My work is assigned to me taking my abilities into account
I can take breaks when I need them
I can decide how much work I do in a day
I can decide the speed at which I work
I can change the order of the activities in my job
I can stop my work for a moment to attend to a personal matter

manejo_cambio.descripcion: The following questions relate to any type of change that occurs in your work.

preguntas.texto: The changes in my job have been beneficial
The changes that occur in my job are clearly explained to me
I can give suggestions about the changes that occur in my job
When changes occur in my job, my ideas and suggestions are taken into account
The changes that occur in my job make my work more difficult

claridad_rol.descripcion: The following questions relate to the information the company has given you about your work.

preguntas.texto: I am clearly informed of what my duties are
I am informed of which decisions I can make in my job
The results I must achieve in my job are clearly explained to me
The effect of my work on the company is clearly explained to me
The objectives of my job are clearly explained to me
I am clearly informed of who can guide me in doing my work
I am clearly informed of whom I can turn to in order to resolve work matters

capacitacion.descripcion: The following questions relate to the education and training the company provides you to do your work.

preguntas.texto: The company allows me to attend training related to my work
I receive useful training to do my work
I receive training that helps me do my work better

liderazgo.descripcion: The following questions relate to the boss or bosses with whom you have the most contact.

preguntas.texto: My boss gives me clear instructions
My boss helps organize the work better
My boss takes my points of view and opinions into account
My boss encourages me to do my work better
My boss distributes tasks in a way that makes my work easier
My boss communicates work-related information to me on time
The guidance my boss gives me helps me do my work better
My boss helps me progress at work
My boss helps me feel good at work
My boss helps solve the problems that arise at work
I feel I can trust my boss
My boss listens to me when I have problems at work
My boss gives me support when I need it

relaciones_sociales.descripcion: The following questions ask about your relationships with other people and the support among the people at your work.

preguntas.texto: I like the atmosphere in my work group
In my work group I am treated respectfully
I feel I can trust my co-workers
I feel comfortable with my co-workers
In my work group some people mistreat me
Among co-workers we solve problems respectfully
My work group is well integrated
My work group is very close-knit

It is easy to get the group to agree on how to do the work
My co-workers help me when I have difficulties
In my job we support one another
Some co-workers listen to me when I have problems

retroalimentacion.descripcion: The following questions relate to the information you receive about your performance at work.

preguntas.texto: I am informed about what I do well in my job
I am informed about what I need to improve in my job
The information I receive about my performance at work is clear
The way my work is evaluated in the company helps me improve

reconocimiento_recompensas.descripcion: The following questions relate to the satisfaction, recognition and security your work offers you.

preguntas.texto: The company trusts my work
The company pays my salary on time
The pay I receive is what the company offered me
The pay I receive is what I deserve for the work I do
In my job I have opportunities to progress
People who do their work well can progress in the company
The company cares about the well-being of its workers
My job in the company is stable
The work I do makes me feel good
I feel proud to work for this company
I speak well of the company to other people

atencion_clientes.instruccion: If your answer was YES, please answer the following questions. If your answer was NO, go to the questions on the next page.

preguntas.texto: I deal with very angry clients or users

I deal with very sad clients or users

My job requires me to attend to people in great need of help

To do my work I must show feelings different from my own
My job requires me to deal with situations of violence
My job requires me to deal with very sad or painful situations

liderazgo_colaboradores.pregunta_filtro: I am the boss of other people at work: Yes / No
liderazgo_colaboradores.instruccion: If your answer was YES, please answer the following questions. If your answer was NO, go to the questions in the next section: GENERAL INFORMATION FORM.

preguntas.texto: Some of the people I supervise communicate work matters late
